Create a production source raster for the APPROVED Arcana fountain plaza concept.
Reference roles in order: 1 = approved plaza concept, main art/design/color authority; 2 and 3 = Stardew outdoor and furniture tilesheets, top/front-plane readability and relative proportions ONLY, do not copy designs or simple style; 4 = projection diagram, geometry ONLY, do not draw the diagram.
Style: richly detailed hand-drawn 2D RPG art with coherent tiny pixel-like color clusters, material-colored contours and layered warm highlights, matching the approved concept. No low-poly 3D, flat vectors, photographic surfaces, thick black outlines, text, UI, labels or watermark.
CAMERA LOCK: front-facing orthographic RPG camera, yaw 0, 45 degrees elevation above the horizontal ground, roll 0. Front horizontal edges level, posts vertical, depth screen-vertical. No perspective convergence or diamond isometric angle. Shared 64 source pixels per world unit. Sunlight from upper left.
ASSET: one square paving-material texture, intended to cover a large part of the existing square at native pixel density. Fill the entire square canvas edge to edge with small irregular warm ivory/beige limestone pavers, like the ground in reference 1. No fountain, ornaments, stars, blue/gold bands, plants, ground cover, people, shadows of objects, or other objects. Existing celestial inlays will be composited separately by the game.
Use many closely fitted slightly rounded non-uniform stones with soft warm gray joints. A stone should be roughly 20-35 pixels wide on the final 1024x1024 texture, giving many stones across the image. Detailed but restrained stone facets, worn rounded edges, tiny cracks, subtle chalky variation, luminous cream high planes, gentle warm-gray recessed seams. Keep overall value around light warm limestone, readable moderate relief. Avoid flat yellow slabs, extremely dark grout, large polygons, square tile grids, checkerboard patterns, conspicuous repeated motifs, grass, or big lighting gradients.
Orthographic view of the ground: no perspective and constant stone size throughout. For flat stones, width/depth reads near 1:0.707. All sides should join naturally for repeated material use, with no visible tile frame. Target output square 1536x1536 if possible. This is a material source, not a whole-scene image.
